summary: MKBHD video comparing the Xiaomi 18 Fold with Apple's newly unveiled foldable 'iPhone Duo'. He explains why the two phones have identical dimensions and near-simultaneous launches (supply-chain leaks, Xiaomi's speed), then compares weight, battery, cameras, crease and selfie camera. He closes with foldable software differences (cover-screen behavior, multi-window limits, back-screen disabling) and a plug for his own desk pad. This is hardware-focused, with no AI content.
relevance_reason: A foldable phone hardware comparison. It doesn't cover AI agents, personal context, voice interfaces or AI-driven OS features. The software notes (fold animations, multitasking, cover-screen behavior) are conventional UI, not AI interaction.

claims.claim: The iPhone Duo allows only two apps side by side, while Android foldables offer richer multi-window and overlay multitasking.
claims.quote: iPhone Duo famously only lets you do two apps side by side

claims.claim: Unlike other foldables, the iPhone Duo doesn't appear to disable the back screen during selfies with the main cameras.
claims.quote: The iPhone Duo actually doesn't seem to do this

claims.claim: The iPhone lights up the outside display as soon as the phone is half closed, whereas Android foldables assume you're done when closed.
claims.quote: As soon as you're halfway done closing it, it lights up the outside display

commercial_interest: The reviewer promotes his own MKBHD desk pad, made with Omnitype, at the end of the video. No sponsorship of the phone discussion is apparent.
older_event: No. The video covers Apple's and Xiaomi's September 2026 unveilings, which are recent, but they are not relevant to the publication's themes.
